+def _normalize_title(value: Any) -> str:
+    """Normalize a title or query for case-insensitive comparison.
+
+    Missing and empty titles normalize to an empty string so they never match a
+    non-empty query.
+    """
+
+    if value is None:
+        return ""
+    return str(value).strip().lower()
+

diff --git a/tests/test_search_tasks.py b/tests/test_search_tasks.py
index 4110daf..572956c 100644
--- a/tests/test_search_tasks.py
+++ b/tests/test_search_tasks.py
@@ -10,5 +10,47 @@ def test_search_is_case_insensitive_and_preserves_order():
     assert [task["id"] for task in search_tasks(tasks, "api")] == [1, 2]
 
 
+def test_search_matches_any_query_casing_with_stable_order():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "title": "Fix API timeout"},
+        {"id": 2, "title": "Write api docs"},
+        {"id": 3, "title": "Clean UI"},
+    ]
+    for query in ("api", "API", "Api"):
+        assert [task["id"] for task in search_tasks(tasks, query)] == [1, 2]
+
+
 def test_search_ignores_tasks_without_a_title():
     assert search_tasks([{"id": 1}, {"id": 2, "title": "API"}], "api") == [{"id": 2, "title": "API"}]
+
+
+def test_search_ignores_missing_none_and_blank_titles():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1},
+        {"id": 2, "title": None},
+        {"id": 3, "title": ""},
+        {"id": 4, "title": "   "},
+        {"id": 5, "title": "Fix API timeout"},
+    ]
+    assert [task["id"] for task in search_tasks(tasks, "api")] == [5]
+    # "none" must not match a task whose title is missing or None.
+    assert search_tasks(tasks, "none") == []
+
+
+def test_search_returns_empty_list_when_nothing_matches():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "title": "Fix API timeout"},
+        {"id": 2, "title": "Write API docs"},
+    ]
+    original = list(tasks)
+    assert search_tasks(tasks, "zzz") == []
+    assert search_tasks(tasks, "release") == []
+    assert tasks == original
+
+
+def test_empty_query_returns_all_tasks():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "title": "Fix API timeout"},
+        {"id": 2, "title": "Write API docs"},
+    ]
+    assert search_tasks(tasks, "") == tasks
